current_answer: At about 13:34 UTC on October 15, 2026, Kalshi’s October Chance headings showed 71% “Fed maintains rate” and 29% “Hike 25bps”; Polymarket’s separate named rows showed 74% “No change” and 26% “25 bps increase.” Both still favored a hold for the October 27–28 FOMC meeting. Against the October 14 evening page checks, their hold readings were 2 and 5 percentage points higher, respectively. BLS reported September final-demand PPI up 1.3% on the month and 6.3% over 12 months at 08:30 ET (12:30 UTC) today. The page checks occurred later, but neither venue exposed a reliable quote time; they do not establish a post-release reaction or its cause. BLS schedules September import and export price indexes for October 16 at 08:30 ET.
